learnings: Weekly NDPSR prices follow the CME spot market with a lag: block (weight on same week -0.02, week before 0.2, two weeks before 0.77; typical miss 2.37%); barrel (weight on same week 0.05, week before 0.29, two weeks before 0.65; typical miss 1.85%); butter (weight on same week 0.19, week before 0.48, two weeks before 0.32; typical miss 1.87%); ndm (weight on same week -0.09, week before 0.15, two weeks before 0.86; typical miss 3.79%); whey (weight on same week -0.11, week before 0.14, two weeks before 0.82; typical miss 7.03%). So by the time a week is published, most of it can be predicted from spot prices already seen.
